duck-parade-family-matching-sweatshirts.print_sentence: A cheerful mother duck leads three little ducklings past tiny hearts and green sprigs, with a hand-lettered "Happy Together" caption, printed on the chest of the same sweatshirt for every family member.
duck-parade-family-matching-sweatshirts.feature_text: One duck family across the chest, the same print in adult and kids sizes, in seven bright colours so the whole family can match or mix shades.
